prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose how you want your pet to live on your desktop and interact with your daily tasks."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into your existing account will safely restore your saved pets and progress."}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Two Column Selection Redesign: Redesign the friend selection screen into a two column layout comparing pet personalities side by side.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Starting Companion", "body": "Compare companion traits and choose the pet that fits your workflow best."}}
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Status Readiness Tip: Add desktop preparation tips and an optional completion notification switch to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Your pet is getting ready! Ensure your desktop background allows app overlays.", "notify_when_ready": true, "show_progress": true}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_placement_guide", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_placement_guide": {"headline": "Locating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Your pet will appear in the bottom right corner of your screen. Look for the tray icon to toggle visibility.", "layout": "centered"}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select How You Wish to Start", "body": "Pick a quick starter pet instantly or spend a moment creating a custom pet tailored to you."}}
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Connection Troubleshooting Hint: Add connection assistance copy and troubleshooting hint directly on the sign-in screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Having trouble signing in? Click here for quick offline setup options or connection help."}}

   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best generation results, upload well-lit photos with a clear subject and clean background."}}
8: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Card Welcome Redesign: Redesign home intro into a card layout displaying quick control shortcuts (hide, summon, speak).
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready!", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, chat, or access settings."}}
9: [choose_path, new_screen] Story Mode Selection Overview Screen: Add a dedicated mode overview screen right after story introducing path capabilities.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_mode_overview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_mode_overview": {"headline": "Understanding Your Playstyle", "body": "Whether you want a low-maintenance desk buddy or a fully custom avatar, we have a path for you.", "layout": "centered"}}

Sign-in account restoration hint provides clear information without violating any rules.
Two-column redesign preserves pet selection functionality.
Adding preparation tips and progress notifications to waiting screen is allowed.
Adding a placement guidance screen before home intro inside onboarding is permitted.
Updated copy maintains both path options (adopting and creating).
Adding connection troubleshooting hint to sign-in screen is compliant.
Adding photo upload quality guidelines is allowed.
Redesigning home intro card inside onboarding is allowed.
Inserting a mode overview screen after story retains all required steps and complies with rules.
